title: Relay dedup keys use mutable hop-by-hop SCHC bytes and no longer suppress loops
description: Correctness review found Node._process_received stores delivery_payload (the received SCHC encoding) in _relay_seen, while forwarding now decompresses, decrements Hop Limit, and recompresses under the next peer's authenticated SCHC context. A looped copy therefore has a different Hop Limit and may also use a different peer-specific encoding, so it will not match the cached bytes; locally originated packets have the same problem. The cache comment still claims it prevents relay loops, but it now only catches byte-identical encodings and allows repeated LoRa forwarding until Hop Limit exhausts. Define a stable authenticated IPv6 datagram identity suitable for dedup (excluding mutable forwarding fields while retaining collision-safe packet identity), use it consistently for RX and local TX, and add multi-hop loop tests with hop-limit changes and different peer compression modes.
notes: Implemented full canonical IPv6 relay identity with Hop Limit normalized, shared RX/local-TX cache path, hit refresh, and loop tests across hop-limit and SCHC encoding changes. Awaiting 3x review; do not close yet.
